create_MJCF_attribute_subclass: create a new MJCF attribute subclass by extending _Attribute and implementing the _assign method
build_Keyword_attribute: build a Keyword attribute with valid_values to restrict an MJCF element to an enumerated set of options
create_Array_attribute: create an Array attribute with a fixed length and dtype to store numeric MJCF element data
review_Identifier_attribute: review the Identifier attribute class to understand how unique element names are managed in a NameScope
test_Reference_attribute: test the Reference attribute to verify it correctly resolves references between MJCF elements by namespace
